## History

Joseph originally belonged to a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) who moved to Vancouver. When [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) moved into Patty's Place with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends, Joseph came along as one of her cats. At first, Joseph engaged in ongoing battles with [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), another cat adopted into the household, but the two eventually became close friends. Later in the girls' final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Joseph participated in the household's chaotic cat antics during an unexpected and awkward visit from Roy's family.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), +7 more_

### [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Joseph is a cat who lives at Patty's Place alongside [Rusty](../character/rusty.md). Initially, the two engaged in ongoing battles with each other after [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) was adopted into the household. However, they eventually overcame their hostility to become close, sworn friends who even sleep on the same cushion.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), +6 more_
